news.title_en: Historically the 2 worst! Index plunges 3440 points; 3 heavyweight stocks hit limit down, TSMC falls 9%
news.summary_en: Trade war reignites; Taiwan stocks yesterday （24） day surged 3310 points, today （25） day immediately staged a massive sell-off, intraday low probed 36681.90 points, plunged 3440.45 points, decline 8.57%, setting a record for the 2 largest intraday point drop in history, yesterday's gains fully erased. news.title: 聯發科技術量能引領產業 今年共17篇論文入選全球頂尖論壇與期刊
news.summary: 聯發科（2454）今日公布，為持續深耕前瞻研發，建構從邊緣AI到雲端AI的完整技術版圖，2026年共計17篇論文入選ISSCC、JSSC、ICML、ECCV、NeurIPS、AAAI、DAC、TVLSI及IEEE Wireless Communications等全球頂尖積體電路設計、AI與通訊領域的國際學術會議與期刊，研究涵蓋邊緣AI、次世代通訊、AI資料中心與AI輔助晶片設計。其中，有5篇論文將於2027年2月在被譽為IC設計界奧林匹克的國際固態電路研討會（2027 IEEE International Solid-State Circuits Conference，ISSCC 2027）發表，為台灣唯一連續24年皆有論文入選ISSCC的企業，累計入選篇數達110篇。
news.title_en: MediaTek's technical capacity leads industry; this year a total of 17 papers selected for global top forums and journals.
news.summary_en: MediaTek （2454） announced today that to continue deepening forward-looking R&D, building a complete technology landscape from edge AI to cloud AI, in 2026 year a total of 17 papers were selected for ISSCC, JSSC, ICML, ECCV, NeurIPS, AAAI, DAC, TVLSI and IEEE Wireless Communications and other global top integrated circuit design, AI and communication fields international academic conferences and journals, research covering edge AI, next-generation communication, AI data centers and AI-assisted chip design. Among them, 5 papers will be presented in 2027 year 2 month at the International Solid-State Circuits Conference, known as the Olympics of IC design, （2027 IEEE International Solid-State Circuits Conference, ISSCC 2027）, making it the only company in Taiwan to have papers selected for ISSCC for 24 consecutive years, with cumulative selected papers reaching 110.

news.title_en: Jensen Huang returns, Taiwan stocks lead Asian stocks! AI party heats up; institutions reveal key to winners 3
news.summary_en: NVIDIA founder Jensen Huang resumes CEO position, Asian stocks today （24） day kick off AI celebration party, Taiwan stocks intraday soar over 3300 points, increase exceeding 9%, leading major Asian markets, TSMC （2330）, Foxconn （2317）, MediaTek （2454） and other AI heavyweight stocks strongly attack top, Korean stocks, Japanese stocks simultaneously surge. However, institutions remind, although Huang's return lets market confidence quickly recover, whether AI stocks can continue rally still requires 3 major keys, including order visibility, financial health, and product pricing power. 《Full text...》

news.title: 鴻海 AI 技術導入醫療 跨步
news.summary: 鴻海攜手台北榮總昨（26）日舉辦「鴻海北榮化療自動化智慧場域發布會暨北海AI中心揭幕」，展示合作一年來的重要成果，透過AI與機器人串聯醫院作業流程，協助醫療人員降低高風險及重複性工作負擔，為智慧醫療導入實際臨床場域建立新模式。
news.title_en: Foxconn AI technology enters healthcare, strides forward
news.summary_en: Foxconn teamed up with Taipei Veterans General Hospital yesterday （26） to hold the 'Foxconn Taipei Veterans Chemotherapy Automation Smart Field Launch and Beihai AI Center Unveiling', displaying key achievements from a year of collaboration. By connecting hospital workflows with AI and robots, it helps medical personnel reduce high-risk and repetitive workloads, establishing a new model for introducing smart healthcare into actual clinical settings.

news.title: 夏普陪伴型AI機器人「Poketomo」12月推出「免費聊」 方案長達13個月
news.summary: 隨著2026年聖誕佳節將近，許多民眾開始為家人挑選兼具心意與實用性的節日禮物。鴻海（2317）旗下台灣夏普（SHARP）宣布，旗下陪伴型AI機器人「Poketomo（口袋同萌）」將於2026年12月1日起正式調整訂閱資費制度，推出全新「免費聊0月費」優惠。自2026年12月1日至2027年12月31日止，用戶可享長達13個月的免月費優惠，每月提供400回免費對話額度，讓科技陪伴更無負擔地走入每個家庭。
news.title_en: Sharp's companion AI robot 'Poketomo' 12 month launches 'Free Chat' plan for up to 13 months
news.summary_en: As 2026 year Christmas approaches, many people start selecting gifts for family that combine thoughtfulness and practicality. Foxconn's （2317） subsidiary Taiwan Sharp (SHARP) announced that its companion AI robot 'Poketomo (Pocket Companion)' will from December 1, 2026 officially adjust subscription pricing, launching new 'Free Chat 0 monthly fee' offer. From December 1, 2026 to December 31, 2027, users can enjoy up to 13 months of free monthly fee benefit, with 400 free conversation quotas per month, allowing tech companionship to enter every household more burden-free.

news.title: 鴻海攜手臺北榮總打造智慧醫療新場域 AI 化療自動化系統正式亮相
news.summary: 鴻海（2317）加速推動AI與機器人技術在智慧醫療領域的應用，攜手臺北榮民總醫院，整合國際技術夥伴資源，打造涵蓋化療藥物調劑、智慧運送及護理協作的醫療自動化系統。雙方26日舉辦「鴻海北榮化療自動化智慧場域發布會暨北海AI中心揭幕」，展示合作一年來的重要成果，透過AI與機器人技術串聯醫院作業流程，協助醫療人員降低高風險及重複性工作負擔，為智慧醫療導入實際臨床場域建立新模式。
news.title_en: Foxconn partners with Taipei Veterans General Hospital to create a new smart healthcare field; AI chemotherapy automation system officially unveiled
news.summary_en: Foxconn （2317） accelerates the promotion of AI and robotics technology applications in the smart healthcare field, partners with Taipei Veterans General Hospital, integrates international technology partner resources, builds a medical automation system covering chemotherapy drug dispensing, smart delivery, and nursing collaboration. Both parties 26 held the 'Foxconn Taipei Veterans Chemotherapy Automation Smart Field Launch and Beihai AI Center Unveiling', showcasing important achievements from a year of cooperation, linking hospital workflow processes through AI and robotics technology, assisting medical staff to reduce high-risk and repetitive workloads, establishing a new model for the introduction of smart healthcare into actual clinical settings.

news.title: ASUS EXPERTHUB 跨出台灣！前進泰國拓展 AI 軟硬整合商機

news.title: 為搶 Amazon Leo！ 衛星頻譜爭議續燒 中華電盼移頻 遠傳：無移頻必要
news.summary: 針對近日外界關注28GHz頻段規劃，中華電信（2412）董事長簡志誠多次呼籲，政府主導協調將28GHz頻譜規劃為專屬Ka頻段的低軌衛星專用，以接軌國際。遠傳（4904）今日特別發出聲明稿指出，行動通信與衛星頻譜共存共用為國際趨勢，現行機制已可兼顧發展，無移頻之必要。

news.summary: 為持續提升供應鏈韌性與國際競爭力，和碩（4938）近期舉辦「2026供應商說明會」暨「低碳轉型供應商說明會」。本次活動採實體與線上同步進行，吸引逾1,000家海內外供應商參與，並攜手國際驗證機構SGS共同舉辦。會中由和碩總經理鄭光志率領品質長謝滿祥，以及現任輪值採購長李佩桂共同出席，正式宣布升級版《供應商行為準則》與全新《品質管控與評鑑標準》，領航夥伴「從合規邁向卓越引領，攜手共創更永續的未來」。

news.title: 台泥歐洲上市 可能選英國
news.summary: 台泥加速全球化布局，董事長張安平昨（25）日在法說會首度透露，歐洲水泥事業上市地點以英國可能性較高；此外，台泥收購烏克蘭水泥廠有望明年首季完成交割，台泥另將鎖定四至五個水泥相關的海外投資據點，未來半年可望有新進展。

news.title: 進口水泥侵蝕三成市場 台泥董座張安平籲政府正視基礎產業發展
news.summary: 台泥（1101）董事長張安平25日表示，低價、高碳排進口水泥大量侵蝕台灣市場，國內水泥業者積極投入低碳轉型，面對進口水泥低價競爭，政府毫無動作。他認為，政府不能只關注高科技產業，而忽視傳統基礎產業的發展。

ai_commentary.summary:
半導體金融雙弱，外資賣超千億，電機機械抗跌。台積電外資大賣股價卻漲，聯發科護城河受質疑，鴻海跌破年線。台達電空頭排列，日月光輝達佔比降。富邦投信大賣，台光電SpaceX題材支撐。南亞外資賣超，南亞科外資買超領先。國泰金法說會前籌碼分歧，整體觀望為主。

整體市場呈現板塊輪動，ETF與機械走強，半導體金融降溫。外資撤離晶圓雙雄與金控，轉向個別題材股。技術面多空分歧，年線攻防關鍵。

台股板塊旋轉明顯，電機機械與ETF領漲，半導體光電金融領跌，外資大幅賣超金融307萬張與半導體86萬張，但買超光電67萬張。千金股多空分歧劇烈，處置股題材輪動，整體量能萎縮，趨勢不明朗，關鍵在法人買賣向向與族群輪動延續性。

台股金融板塊普遍承壓，外資連續賣超金控股，技術面多呈現空頭排列；科技股分化明顯，研華、緯創基本面支撐較強，但金像電、臻鼎短線獲利了結壓力大。整體籌碼面投信接盤、外資減碼，市場觀望氣氛濃厚，待關鍵支撐位驗證。

台股板塊分化明顯，半導體金融走弱，電子代工緯穎逆勢大漲，ETF放量上漲外資連賣，科技群高度同向震盪，資金輪動尋找題材股支撐。

台股板塊分化，金融外資大賣，瑞昱AI題材領漲，群創法人買超國家隊賣，封測京元爆量，遠傳技術弱，萬海抗跌，彰銀籌碼流出，多空未定觀望。

台股板塊分化，電機ETF領漲，半導體金融外資賣超。衛星、AI伺服、重電題材輪動，動能分歧法人籌碼不一，觀察量能能否配合題材延續。

台股板塊分化明顯，ETF與電機機械走強，半導體光電航運走弱。外資大幅賣超金融半導體，買超航運租賃。個股多呈現年線下方整理，法人籌碼分歧擴大，短線關注量能能否配合關鍵均線突破，確認趨向方向。

台股板塊分化，電機機械走強、半導體金融疲軟，玻璃陶瓷領跌。多檔個股獲利優但技術面偏弱，外資賣超明顯，籌碼面承壓。

大盤板塊分化明顯，電機機械、ETF偏暖，半導體、光電、金融轉冷。外資連賣半導體金融，航運外資買超。多數標的技術偏弱，RSI中低檔，MACD多空交織，籌碼無共識，整體觀望。

台股整體呈現板塊分化，ETF板塊領漲2.33%但外資五日賣超16.7萬張，半導體、金融等權值股走弱拖累大盤，市場觀望情濃厚，籌碼面偏向分發，短線缺乏明確方向指引。

Foreign capital exits semiconductors and financials but selects specific names. Technicals mostly sideways with divergent momentum; institutional flows mixed across sectors.

Financials face foreign selling despite sustainability accolades. Heat dissipation and measurement plays see event-driven volatility. Overall cautious bias with selective accumulation in oversold quality names.

Financials lead declines with heavy foreign selling across mega-cap banks despite earnings resilience. Technology mixed: 2395 gains on edge AI outlook while 2368, 3231, 4958 retreat after sharp rallies. Broad market shows sector rotation with financials distributing and select tech absorbing profit-taking.

Market mixed with tech sectors cooling; semiconductors, financials, networking under foreign selling pressure while machinery and ETFs gain. High sector correlations amplify directional moves.

Mixed signals across sectors; financials and telecoms show technical weakness despite fundamental stability, while semiconductors diverge with 2379 outperforming amid networking optimism. Institutional flows remain selective, favoring oversold names in panels and foundries but exiting banks.

Foreign sellers dominate chips (-86K) and financials (-307K) but accumulate shipping (+52K) and optical (+67K). Theme-driven momentum in satellite, AI power, and memory contrasts with structural downtrends in steel and PCB names.

Taiwan market shows mixed signals with semiconductors and electronics cooling under heavy foreign selling while financials face broad distribution; shipping and machinery sectors display relative resilience amid institutional rotation; AI-exposed names undergo profit-taking as defensive banks attract selective foreign buying interest.

Sector rotation mixed: Electric Machinery and ETFs warm, Semiconductors, Finance, Glass/Ceramic cold. Foreign investors heavily sold Finance (-307K), Semiconductors (-86K), Glass/Ceramic (-96K). 6213, 2834, 1802, 2324, 1605 show bearish technicals with foreign selling; 1504, 6139 see foreign buying. Earnings strength in 6213, 2834, 1605 contrasts price weakness.

Mixed sector rotation: machinery and ETFs warm, semiconductors cool with heavy foreign selling; oversold tech names show divergence while defensive rails gain on volume.

The Taiwan market shows mixed sector rotation with ETFs leading gains while semiconductors and financials lag. Foreign investors sold heavily across major sectors including a 167k share net sell in ETFs. Technical breadth remains divergent with semiconductor correlation to other tech sectors above 0.95. 0050 trades below both MA20 and MA60 with bearish momentum but KD golden cross.
